svg.aria-label: What changes. Left, before: claude-code-style's inventory rules live in its own test folder, hard-wired to its entry and its type list; FIX-2629's closure goal reaches into that folder; Teammates and Shift Manager have no inventory, so nothing measures a child or stops a finding. Right, after: one shared module in labs/test-support takes each app's settings; claude-code-style, Teammates and Shift Manager each call it from pnpm test; Teammates and Shift Manager each keep an allowlist that is compared with the merge-base and a line limit on their read-model files; the closure goal calls the same module.

g.text: BEFORE · ONE APP'S RULES, IN ITS TEST FOLDER
CLAUDE-CODE-STYLE TEST
inventory-rules.ts: L1 to L4, H
its entry, its type list and its folder, wired in
FIX-2629 CLOSURE GOAL
Reaches into that lab's test folder
grades claude-code-style only
TEAMMATES · SHIFT MANAGER
No inventory at all
66 and 162 findings today; nothing measures a child
AFTER · ONE MODULE, EACH APP'S SETTINGS
LABS/TEST-SUPPORT/INVENTORY.TS
The same rules, given an app's settings
entry, rules, screen types, gone files, read-model files
TEAMMATES · SHIFT MANAGER
pnpm test with an allowlist that only shrinks
compared with the merge-base · read-model files can't grow
CLAUDE-CODE-STYLE
The same test, from the shared module
an empty allowlist · its verdict unchanged
THE CLOSURE GOALS
FIX-2629's, and FIX-2778's to come
call the same module; FIX-2778 needs both allowlists empty
